node_definition.done_when: Done when a new tests/test_a_deferred_promotion_resolves_the_gate_program.py builds a temporary repository holding an executable .venv/bin/python and a run whose recorded gate command is PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/x.py . It calls the check with the process working directory set to an unrelated temporary directory, and the check passes. A second case, where the repository holds no such file, is refused with a message naming the repository path. The negative control restores resolution against the working directory, and the first case is then refused. The test files importing reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py add no failure against the base revision, run on the all_debug partition one arm at a time with at most -n 4 . Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py , tests/test_a_deferred_promotion_resolves_the_gate_program.py and the node's fragment.
